title: Map Architecture & Objectives
lede: Spatial geography, terrain traversal mechanics, dynamic resource placement, and map objectives.

grid.coordinateSystem: Cartesian (x, y) where (0,0) is North-West and (24,24) is South-East
grid.neighborhoodModel: Moore Neighborhood (3x3 grid centered on agent, 8 neighbors + center)

terrains.name: Plains / Savanna
terrains.description: Open expanse allowing swift unimpeded locomotion but zero concealment from predators.

terrains.name: Temperate Forest
terrains.description: Dense foliage providing cover for ambushes and shelter from harsh winter conditions.

terrains.name: Dense Jungle
terrains.description: Thick tropical canopy rich in plant forage but demanding severe energy expenditure to traverse.

terrains.name: Swamp / Marsh
terrains.description: Muddy wetlands posing a 10% risk of waterborne sickness per turn if traversed.

terrains.name: Freshwater Lake
terrains.description: Vital hydration stations. Drinking restores 40 Thirst points.

terrains.name: Rocky Mountains
terrains.description: Natural geographic boundaries that funnel migration and block linear pathing.

principles: No two animal agents spawn in adjacent tiles on turn 0, preventing instant turn-1 death.
Water nodes are clustered into natural lakes with a minimum 4-tile distance between separate water bodies.
Flora nodes distribute evenly across Plains, Forest, and Jungle with an initial 15% coverage.
Carnivores, Herbivores, and Omnivores spawn at fixed species ratios (50% herbivores, 30% omnivores, 20% carnivores) to maintain an ecologically viable food pyramid.

mapObjectives.name: Territorial Scouting
mapObjectives.target: Visit all 4 quadrants of the arena to maximize exploration fitness bonuses.

mapObjectives.name: Resource Control
mapObjectives.target: Secure and defend access to perennial freshwater sources against rival packs.

mapObjectives.name: Disaster Evacuation
mapObjectives.target: Migrate out of flagged disaster epicenter zones before countdown timers expire.
